# Things That Hunt
The Colossus sector kills people. Most of it is ordinary: vacuum, hunger, a pirate with a cannon. Some of it is not.
This chapter is about the things that are not.
- [textlink="The Monolith" link="WFLoreMonolith"]: black stones that give, and what they take back. - [textlink="Chimera" link="WFLoreChimera"]: the bio-weapon that ate a world. - [textlink="Xenonids" link="WFLoreXenonids"]: the hives under Aerumna.
